overall: The AG found the Norwood Skating Rink Committee is a local, not regional, public body, so it did not violate the Open Meeting Law by using local rather than regional notice-posting rules for its May 27 meeting; the complaint was also found timely.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee is a regional public body and so failed on May 27 to follow regional notice-posting requirements.
